tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bse khrab can nam/ tshangs pa dung thod can nam/ rnam sras mdung dmar ram/ gnyan chen thang lha sogs rnam 'gyur dang mtshan tha dad kyi srung ma ngo bo gcig pa gsang phu ba'i gsol mchod rngog lo'i rjes 'dzin bzhugs so// na mo gu ru padma kro dhā ya/ dpal sa skya'i chos las pa chen po red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyis bla brang dga' ldan zhes grags pa 'dir sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan can gyi sku thog la rngog lo blo ldan shes rab kyi bka' srung gsang ne'u thog gi chos grwa chen po'i gnas bdag rgyal chen bse khrab can du grags pa 'di 'khor ba'i thugs snang shar ba bzhin zhal 'bag bzhugs pa'i mgon khang mdzad de gtor spod chen mo'i bsdus ru dang chabs cig gtor ma spo 'dzugs mdzad pa bcas kyi chos skyong 'di'i chos skor yer pa'i gtor ma yin zer ba zhig yod tshod 'dug kyang / gong sa lnga pa chen pos khungs ma dag par mdzad de/ gong sa lnga pa chen po rang gi thugs bzhed rnying lugs dgongs 'dus chos skor gyi srung ma btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun gyi gras yin gsungs pa 'dug kyang / gsang phu ba don grub legs bzang dang / sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan can ni yer pa'i gtor ma de khungs ma yin par bzhed/ gang ltar me khyi lo nas bzung dga' ldan mgon khang du bse khrab can gyi gtor ma gru gsum pa gcig btsugs te lo gnang dus kyi bsdus ru dang chabs cig yod rgyu'i bskang gso gtong tshul ni/ phur chung gtor bsngo bshags pa gsum/ bskang ba thugs dam ma shur ma/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rdzogs pa dang / /rnga brdung 'dur shur gang rung gis/ /stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥyig dmar po las/ /'od 'phros gdug can tshar bcad tshur 'dus thim/ /de nyid yongs gyur rgyal ba'i bstan srung che/ /chos skyong bse yi khrab can sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs/ /g.yas pa bing chen klad bskor dmag tshogs 'dren/

/g.yon pa bdud zhags khra bo thugs khar 'dzin/ /dar dmar gyis mdzes bse rmog dbu la gsol/ /dar gyi stod g.yogs 'jol ber sna tshogs kyis/ /steng na bse khrab khra bo sku la gsol/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon na bsnams/ /rlung gi shugs 'chang stong gsum ma lus pa/ /skad cig bgrod pa'i rta mchog rag pa chibs/ /me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /mchod gtor rgya chen 'bul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ /de yi g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab phyogs mtshams bzhir/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /sprul pa 'bum dang yang sprul pho nyar bcas/ /thams cad khro zhi dgra la rngams shing rgod/ /'ur 'ur chem chem sgra yis stong gsum khengs/ /bstan dgra tshar gcod bstan 'dzin sde skyong ba'i/ /las la skad cig tsam yang mi g.yel bar/ /sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs su gsol la tshig rol/ hūm̐ rab dmar srin po khros 'dras sa 'dzin khengs/ /sog po'i sna ltar mkha' la snyegs pa'i gnas/ /rab bzhugs khro bo'i rgyal po bse khrab can/ /ma thogs myur du bsgral ba'i las la byon/ /bde ba'i dpal ster bkra shis lha yi khang / /sum cu rtsa gsum chos kyi pho brang nas/ /sngags srung nag po mthu stobs drag po che/ /las bzhi bsgrub phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rgya gar u rgyan bod yul gtsug lag khang / /ma lus bsrung mar khas blangs dpa' bo che/ /mna' zan tshe srog 'bral ba'i las la brtson/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes shlau ka gsum po 'di la myur mgyogs sde brgyad ma'i dbyangs rol shlau ka re re rdzogs mtshams dzar dang gsum brdeg len bcas/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gcig po/ /snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po'i chas su ston/ /rgyud sde'i snying po'i 'gro don gter du sbas/ /pad ma'i bka' bstod gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sngon tshe lo chen blo ldan shes rab kyis/

/bod yul bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa/ /chos skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig la dgongs nas/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon rgyal chen bse khrab can/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun sgrub pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /rje yi rgyal po sprul pa yang sprul dang / /las mkhan pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ /sbrel nas/ phan bde kun 'byung ma rgyun bzhin la chem brdung gi tshe/ oṃ hrīḥm hā rā dza sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes dang / spyan 'dren gyi rol mo thams cad la rkang gling / ka ba keng rus ma shlau ka gcig rol mo chem brdung la/ oṃ hrīḥm hā rā dza sa pā ri wā ra a shwa a pa na tiṣṭhantu/ zhes dang rol skor 'bebs bcas/ oṃ hrīḥm hā rā dza sa pā ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos/ oṃ hrīḥm hā rā dza sa pā ri wā ra a nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyi phyi mchod/ oṃ hrīḥm hā rā dza sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po bse khrab can 'khor dang bcas khyed rnams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bskang rdzas sogs 'phrin bcol gsungs rgyun bzhin/ hūm̐ rtsa re bshams pa nas/ bya nag tshogs bar la lha mchog ma'i mchod dbyangs 'dur gdangs ma bcug la/ rkang gling rgyun bzhin dang / khyed la 'bul bzhes dang / rol mo blangs nas/ pa re sogs tshig rkang gsum la rol skor/ mdzad ces pa la nems/ du dang gsol la che ba/ tsa tur nas dbyangs gyi 'phros/ tshogs zhes pa dang rol mo blangs nas/ gsum brdeg brel ba dang dal ba ste lha mchog ma sor bzhag zha nye ma 'dres nas rgyas par mdzod kyi bar rgyun bzhin la chem brdung med pa/

hrīḥlas byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /sku mdog dmar po bse khrab can/ /sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol/ /dbu la bse rmog dmar po gsol/ /shlau ka gcig po 'di la nag po gnod sbyin ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin 'dur shur gang rung gis/ phyag na mdung dmar ba dan can/ /bstan dgra thal bar brlag byed pa'i/ /mthu chen drag po'i thugs dam༞ /chos rgyal chen po'i thugs dam༞ /bse khrab can gyi thugs dam༞ /bdud btsal rgyal po'i thugs dam༞ /mdung dmar can gyi thugs dam༞ /ces pa 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre bya'o/ /hūm̐ rin chen lnga yi rgyan cha dang / /thod skam lnga yi cod paṇa dang / /gdug pa can gyi mgo bo'i phreng / /khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /bse khrab bse rmog bse phub dang / /mdung dmar dgra satwa mda' gzhu dang / /yid 'ong mtshon cha mang po yis/ /mthu chen༞ ༞༞༞༞ /hūm̐ rnga chen dung chen gling bu dang / /cha lang rkang gling rgya gling sogs/ /yid 'ong sgra snyan mang po yis/ /mthu chen༞ ༞༞༞༞ /hūm̐ dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / /tshil chen spos kyi dud sprin dang / /zhun chen sgron me 'bar ba dang / /khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i dri chab dang / /khrag zhag sha rus gtams pa yi/ /zhal zas bshos bu dmar nag dang / /rin chen lnga dang snying po lnga/ /sna tshogs ro bcud ldan pa'i zas/ /mthu chen༞ ༞༞༞༞ /hūm̐ rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang rta mchog dang / /gshog skor byed pa'i bya dmar dang / /'kheng zhing zug pa'i khyi dmar dang / /'bros 'ded byed pa'i lce spyang dang / /mdangs dang ldan pa'i g.yag nag dang / /stobs dang ldan pa'i stag gzig sogs/ /sprul pa'i dud 'gro sna tshogs pas/ /mthu chen༞ ༞༞༞༞ /hūm̐ g.yas na sku yi sprul pa ni/ /ne'u klu btsan ber nag can/ /chibs su chu rta mthing nag chibs/ /sbrul 'bum sde brgyad sprul pa 'gyed/ /lcags kyi sdigs pa khro lo lo/ /zangs kyi sbal pa chi li li/ /g.yu yi lcang mo nyi li li/

/rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon gzhan gyi byad kha sogs/ /lus kyi bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la rol/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag la rol/ /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /til 'bru tsam yang med par mdzod/ /dus la bab bo phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ g.yon na gsung gi sprul pa ni/ /btsan gyi rgyal po bse khrab can/ /sku mdog dmar nag ber chen gsol/ /chibs su btsan rta dmar po chibs/ /spre'u dmar po pho nyar 'gyed/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis/ /nad gdon gzhan gyi byad kha sogs/ /ngag gi bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la rol/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag la rol/ /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /til 'bru tsam yang med par mdzod/ /dus la bab bo phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ mdun na thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /lha yi srung ma gos dkar can/ /chibs su lha rta dkar po chibs/ /nyan thos dge slong sprul pa 'gyed/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /nad gdon gzhan༞ /sems kyi bar༞ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la rol/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag la rol/ /rus pa klad pa༞ /til 'bru༞ /dus la༞ /hūm̐ rgyab tu yon tan sprul pa ni/ /chos gtor srung ma gos dkar can/ /chibs su mtsha' lu rting dkar chibs/ /byi la gwa pa sprul pa 'gyed/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /nad gdon gzhan gyi༞ /yon tan bar chad༞ /dam nyams༞ /dam nyams dgra༞ /rus pa klad pa༞ /til 'bru༞ /dus la bab bo༞ /hūm̐ mtshams bzhir phrin las sprul pa ni/ /sku mdog dmar ser dmag chas can/ /chibs su rag pa rting dkar chibs/ /sku la bse khrab khra bo gsol/ /sdig pa nag po pho nyar 'gyed/ /rgyan gyi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /nad gdon gzhan༞ /phrin las bar chad༞ /dam nyams༞ /dam nyams༞ /rus pa klad pa༞ /til 'bru༞ /dus la bab༞ /hūm̐ steng na rje yi sprul pa ni/ /za 'og dmar khra sku la gsol/

/chibs su cang shes bra nag chibs/ /dpa' bo stag chas sprul pa 'gyed/ /rgyan gyi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /nad gdon gzhan༞ /'gal rkyen bar༞ /dam nyams༞ /dam nyams dgra bo'i༞ /rus pa klad pa༞ /til 'bru༞ /dus la bab༞ /tshig rol/ hūm̐ thub pa'i rgyal tshab blo ldan shes rab kyis/ /bka' lung srog ltar mdud pa dam bcas nas/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i bya ra ba/ /bka' sdod stobs ldan khyed la bdag bstod do/ /shlau ka gcig la bde chen lhun 'grub ma'i dbyangs rol/ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ /bse yi khrab can bka' bstod pho nyar bcas/ /mchod gtor bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /rnam dkar phrin las spel ba'i las mdzod cig /tshig rol/ thub pa'i bstan pa dpal ldan ra ba rmad/ /blo gsal phye ba'i tshogs kyis yongs gang nas/ /smra ba'i nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kyis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel ba'i las mdzod cig /sngon tshe lo chen blo ldan shes rab kyis/ /mi 'bral lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon du khyed bsngags pas/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba'i las mdzod cig /sa skya'i rje btsun ma'i dbyangs shlau ka gnyis pa nas myur ba dang rol mo bcas/ khyad par bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /bshad sgrub chu bo'i rgyun ltar gnas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bus 'dzin ma'i khyon gang nas/ /legs bshad rgyal rnga srid na mtho bar mdzod/ /bstan pa'i rū tra las ngan sdig can rnams/ /skad cig tsam la thal bar rlog pa dang / /bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog la tshig rol chem brdung gsum brdeg len can/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma sogs bskang ba'i 'phros bstod pa nag rngams ma/
